    candidates = []
    seen = set()

    def _canon(terms, mod_l, mod_m):

        This avoids over-canonicalizing by the lexicographically smallest term, which
        can differ across equivalent translations for mixed x/y supports and can
        accidentally collapse distinct structures.
        """

            return tuple()
        xs = [x for x, _ in terms]
        min_x = min(xs)
        ys_at_min_x = [y for (x, y) in terms if x == min_x]
        min_y = min(ys_at_min_x) if ys_at_min_x else 0
        return tuple(sorted([((x - min_x) % mod_l, (y - min_y) % mod_m) for (x, y) in terms]))

            f = (3 * e) % ell
